summary: Implemented unknown-total speed display in rich/progress.py: track() gained show_speed (default True) passed to TaskProgressColumn; TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed (default False), a static render_speed method using filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix, and a render override that shows speed when total is unknown. Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables without a total. Added the CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added line, removed the two ValueError assertions in tests/test_progress.py, and added test_task_progress_column_speed. Nothing was run: tests, mypy, and black are unverified, and changes are uncommitted.
